maya: quick snapshot — ran Mercurion-11b bring-up across fp16/int8/int4 this morning. attaching abbreviated unit-econ + quality takeaways. want product/GTN guidance on rollout.
sam: TL;DR numbers: fp16 baseline: p95 latency 95ms, thrpt 90rps, cost $1.20 per 1k tokens. int8: p95 120ms, thrpt 80rps, cost $0.55 per 1k tokens, QA delta ~ -0.9% EM on GTN tests. int4: p95 240ms, thrpt 40rps, cost $0.32 per 1k tokens, QA delta ~ -3.6% EM and big regressions on long-code slices.
ritika: short quality notes: conversational QA and summarization hold up on int8 (minor fluency drops). codegen and multi-turn retrieval use cases show hallucination spike at int4. sample slice: `code_long_5k` EM dropped from 72 -> 58.
alex: Ops notes: int4 kernel suffers KV cache fragmentation; we saw tail latency spikes when context >2048. recommend warmstart cache and smaller batch sizes if trying int4 in prod.
maya: Proposed pragmatics for GTN/product: 1) Canary int8 @ 5% for low-risk routes (short chat, embeds). 2) Keep fp16 for codegen / longform / paid features. 3) Do an A/B on int8 where we track per-route EM, latencies, cost per 1k tokens, and user-facing regression alerts. 4) If int4 run: isolate to internal-only and 0-1% traffic, with rollback automation.
sam: Suggested routing config snippet for canary:
```
routing:
  - route: short-chat
    model: mercurion-11b-int8
    weight: 0.05
  - route: codegen
    model: mercurion-11b-fp16
    weight: 0.95
```
ritika: Scorecard (quick): metrics tracked = [EM, Rouge-L, p95 latency, cost_per_1k, regression-rate]. current snapshot: fp16 EM 86.2, int8 EM 85.3, int4 EM 82.6. regression-rate (user-affecting slices) int8 0.8%, int4 4.9%.
alex: Ops checklist before canary: deploy int8 image to dedicated pool, enable per-request tracing, set fallback policy `on_quality_degrade -> fp16`, add cost dashboards.
maya: Final recommendation: ship int8 canary to GTN for non-code flows, hold int4 until we fix KV cache and run targeted evals on long-context/code slices. if GTN wants aggressive cost cuts, propose hybrid routing + cached prefix to recover costs without full int4 rollout. :thumbsup:
